SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation is bundled as sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h.
Official source: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip
SQLite is in the public domain: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

The application and database layer are compiled as C. Runtime interface,
image decoding and password derivation use Windows system APIs.
The bundled interface illustrations and icons were created for this project.
